meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把视频脚本一键渲染、预览并发布到本地或云端
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要把视频画面批量渲染成成品并发布。
copy.tagline_en: Render, preview, and publish video compositions locally or to the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you routinely render and publish video compositions in batches.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会用 npx hyperframes 命令帮你搭建视频项目、搜索本地动效、编写合成、跑检查与预览,最后渲染出 MP4 文件,也能排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要新建或修改 HyperFrames 视频项目,或需要排查构建、渲染失败时触发。

howto.what_en: Installs a CLI workflow: Claude scaffolds a HyperFrames video project, searches a local motion catalog, authors the composition, lints, checks and previews it, then renders an MP4 locally or on cloud, and can diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Use when creating or editing a HyperFrames video project, or when diagnosing build or render failures.
